description: Build a Retry-After response header value from either a non-negative delay in seconds or a target date/time, per RFC 9110 Section 10.2.3. A date is formatted as an HTTP-date (IMF-fixdate, e.g. "Wed, 21 Oct 2026 07:28:00 GMT"), the only date format the header allows.

date.description: A target date/time string to format as an HTTP-date (required unless seconds is given)

seconds.description: A non-negative delay in seconds (required unless date is given)

name: build_retry_after_header
